name: Biting the Hand
summary: Fuzzle offers trade to anyone who helps him get revenge. He promises to show you treasure once you bring him Twilight Finger Bones.

sections.title: Fuzzle's Offer
sections.body: A bit of gold changes hands as Fuzzle offers you a bargain. The gnoll promises more treasure if you help him get revenge. He asks you to bring him twenty Twilight Finger Bones before he shows you what he has.

faq.answer: Fuzzle is a gnoll who offers you gold and promises treasure in exchange for help getting revenge.
Fuzzle asks you to bring him twenty Twilight Finger Bones to help him get revenge.

faq.q: What are the Twilight Finger Bones for?
faq.answer: Fuzzle wants twenty Twilight Finger Bones before he shows you his treasure.

attribution: In-game quest text: Biting the Hand
